name: pace-lift
about: The user lifts claude's pacing (#316, `loop pace normal --until reset`): with a 5h budget of 60k, one claude build takes the window to 89% and claims slow down. The user lifts pacing until the next limit hit: the orchestrator's notebook gets the user's call, the next claim runs at the normal pace and #loop-digest says why (budgets and the CLI's warnings no longer slow claims; a limit hit would still pause them and end the lift).

messages.text: ^Pacing claude: the 5h window is at \d+% of its budget
^Claude claims back to normal: you lifted pacing until the next limit hit\.$
